name: csv-dialect
objective: Make NONNUMERIC CSV dialect parsing honor the documented string-valued filesystem model contract, preserving original cell spelling and source provenance. Preserve custom dialects, decode/parse consistency, serialization round trips and malformed-input rejection. Investigate the code and tests before proposing a one-file correction.
oracle:
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.resources.filesystem import CsvCodec, CsvDialect, CsvQuoting, FileFormatError
codec = CsvCodec()
path = resolve_path(Path.cwd() / '.local/unwritten-cohort.csv')
dialect = CsvDialect(quoting=CsvQuoting.NONNUMERIC)
sources = [('"id","name"\n1,"Ada"\n', ('id', 'name'), ('1', 'Ada')),
           ('"id","value"\n001,1.50\n', ('id', 'value'), ('001', '1.50')),
           ('"id","value"\n1e2,-0\n', ('id', 'value'), ('1e2', '-0'))]
for text, headers, cells in sources:
    try:
        file = codec.parse(path, text, dialect=dialect)
    except Exception as error:
        raise AssertionError('NONNUMERIC must retain exact string-valued cells') from error
    assert file.headers == headers and file[0].values() == cells
    assert file.content == text and file.byte_size == len(text.encode())
    assert all(isinstance(value, str) for value in file[0])
    assert codec.parse(path, codec.serialize(file), dialect=dialect).rows == file.rows
    assert codec.decode(path, text.encode(), dialect=dialect).rows == file.rows
custom = CsvDialect(delimiter=';', quoting=CsvQuoting.NONNUMERIC)
assert codec.parse(path, '"id";"value"\n007;"x;y"\n', dialect=custom)[0].values() == ('007', 'x;y')
assert codec.parse(path, 'id,value\n1,2\n')[0].values() == ('1', '2')
for text in ('"id","value"\n1\n', '"id","id"\n1,2\n', '"id","value"\n"unterminated'):
    try:
        codec.parse(path, text, dialect=dialect)
    except FileFormatError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('invalid CSV accepted')
print('CSV_ACCEPTANCE_PASS')
